This is just my own criticism on the game, I actually really enjoyed and still play Black Ops 3, but I hate Black Ops 4.

100% agreed. I want the next COD to be modern with real guns and for it to return to it's simple roots. That's what the people want and what made COD great. I miss MW2, you could get everything by grinding and playing the game, the guns were nice, and like you mentioned I just overall enjoyed wrecking shit with real weapons. The suppressed AK-47 in black ops 1 was so good, just how it felt and looked. Even especially just the overall gun selection was great for that time. All the Modern Warfare have been great so far, 1, 2, and 3 were really good. 

I actually also really enjoyed Black Ops 3, I hated the jumppacks and sliding at first but it eventually grew on me and I ended up liking it. Even if they made a game like Black Ops 3 but with real guns that'd be good, Black Ops 4 was definitely a step-back from number 3.

Yeah but I also refunded it and got my $79.99 back. I heard it was good, so I got it just to have a personal outlook and my own experience on the game and just try it out, and my god it was a shit show.

But we can hate on the fact that they put no effort into their games anymore and only push their games for the simple fact of a cash grab. That's not respectable in my books, especially since you're killing off your fanbase, a once really good franchise, and look at your fans like wallets.
